themes.label: GLP-1 and metabolic disease demand
themes.rationale: AZN has expanded oral and injectable metabolic assets (e.g. AZD5004, partnerships) to compete in the GLP-1/obesity wave reshaping pharma pipelines and payer spend; exposure is emerging rather than dominant versus Novo/Lilly.

themes.label: Oncology and biologics pipeline shift
themes.rationale: AZN's growth is heavily driven by oncology franchises (Tagrisso, Enhertu, Imfinzi) and biologics/ADC platforms, reflecting an industry-wide pivot from small-molecule primary care drugs to targeted biologic oncology therapies.

themes.label: Patent cliff and loss-of-exclusivity risk
themes.rationale: Several AZN blockbusters face upcoming exclusivity loss this decade, a structural force across large pharma forcing pipeline replacement and M&A to offset revenue erosion from generics/biosimilars.

themes.label: China pharma market and policy exposure
themes.rationale: AZN has significant China revenue exposure subject to volume-based procurement pricing pressure and regulatory shifts, a recurring theme for multinational pharma reliant on Chinese market growth.

themes.label: Biologics and cell therapy manufacturing buildout
themes.rationale: AZN is investing in biologics, ADC and cell therapy manufacturing capacity to support pipeline shift, linking it to broader industry capital spend on advanced biomanufacturing infrastructure.
